exact_source_findings.dispatcher_gate: The stock Service<RoleServer>::handle_request calls validate_tasks_capability before invoking ServerHandler get_task/update_task/cancel_task. A custom ServerHandler override therefore retains the standard Tasks-extension capability gate provided the application does not replace/bypass the stock Service dispatch.
exact_source_findings.stock_task_manager_get: TaskManager::get_task(&str) sweeps expiry, fails unknown task ids, refreshes status from terminal/pending-input/working state, and returns DetailedTask.
exact_source_findings.stock_task_manager_update: TaskManager::update_task(&str, IntoIterator<Item=(String, serde_json::Value)>) accepts partial inputResponses and ignores unknown/already-answered/superseded keys per source comment.
exact_source_findings.stock_task_manager_cancel: TaskManager::cancel_task(&str) sweeps expiry, fails unknown task ids, sets cancel_requested=true, signals cooperative cancellation, clears pending input senders for nonterminal tasks, and leaves observable status working until the operation settles. The operation may finally settle cancelled, failed, or completed.
